name: Zimri
title: King of Israel for seven days
summary: Zimri was an officer in the army of Israel who conspired against King Elah and killed him to seize the throne. His reign lasted only seven days before Omri, the commander-in-chief of the army, was proclaimed king and laid siege to Tirzah, which led Zimri to set fire to the royal palace and perish in the flames.

keyEvents.title: Conspiracy against King Elah
keyEvents.description: Zimri, who was commander over half the chariots, conspired against King Elah while he was getting drunk in Tirzah.

keyEvents.title: The murder of King Elah
keyEvents.description: Zimri went in and struck Elah down in the house of Arza, the steward at Tirzah, and became king in his place.

keyEvents.title: The destruction of Baasha's house
keyEvents.description: Shimri wiped out the entire house of Baasha in accordance with the Lord's word through the prophet Jehu, and killed all his relatives and friends.

keyEvents.title: Omri Proclaimed King
keyEvents.description: When the army of Israel that was camped against the Philistines heard about Shimri's conspiracy, they proclaimed their commander Omri king over Israel.

keyEvents.title: The Siege of Tirzah
keyEvents.description: Omri marched up from Gibbethon with all Israel and besieged Tirzah, the capital where Shimri had taken refuge.

keyEvents.title: Shimri's Death by Fire
keyEvents.description: When Shimri saw that the city was captured, he went into the citadel of the king's house and set fire to it over himself, dying for his sins.
